environment: Shared scratch CPU, one PyTorch thread; no GPU rentals or production services
initial_attempt: One long training process exited with status137 after saving bptt seed1 equal-data and weighted-denoising seed1 equal-data. No diagnostic identified the kill cause. Another accounting process was concurrent; later work ran short sequential jobs.
recovery: Preserved completed endpoints. Replayed weighted seed1 from its same fixed seed; equal-data test BPB was exactly identical. Remaining work uses separate run_one.py jobs capped at180 CPU seconds each. Initial monolithic launcher bound was1200 CPU seconds.
timing_caveat: Budget times include cold-start effects inside training. In particular bptt seed1 recorded63.52 CPU seconds versus roughly25 seconds suggested by isolated warmed timing. Extended runs may hit the predeclared3000-update cap before equal CPU; label such endpoints capped_cpu rather than matched. Use accounting.py warmed step timing for speed comparisons, not the anomalous cold first run.
cost_scope: Endpoint training times exclude evaluation, package setup, failed or replayed work and accounting. They are not end-to-end project cost. All scratch work incurred no new user-paid resources.
public_code_weighting: Official ViT model.py, inspected read-only, multiplies a length-N CE vector by N-by-1 weights, broadcasting to N-by-N. This pilot primary implements intended per-example weighting; its prespecified secondary is unweighted CE. Neither is claimed identical to the unpublished recurrent-depth LM implementation.
diagnostic_scope: Additional decoder-depth/particle checks are post-hoc validation-only diagnostics, not test-set tuning or a replacement primary result.
second_interruption: Later shell batch exited137 during diffusion_ce seed3 after saving equal-data endpoint; exact cause unknown. Replayed that one method in an isolated job and ran final Transformer control separately. Equal-data score again matched exactly.
data_download_test: Fresh pinned public train, validation and test parquet files were downloaded and reconstructed independently; all hashes matched.
